item.title: They Found Her Car But Not The Truth
item.description: Sixteen-year-old Kiely Rodni disappeared after attending a party in California, sparking a massive search involving hundreds of volunteers and investigators. Days later, her car was discovered submerged in a reservoir, but the circumstances surrounding her final hours continue to raise difficult questions.

item.title: She Was Found Dead In Her School Bathroom
item.description: Thirteen-year-old Ta'ir Rada was found murdered inside her school's bathroom in Israel in 2006. The investigation led to a controversial conviction, years of appeals, disputed forensic evidence, and intense public debate, making it one of the country's most divisive and closely followed criminal cases.
